review.rationale: Option A soundly recommends exactly one fail-closed, local-only validation of the prepared 16-file CE-G13 input-binding supplement. The recommendation explicitly binds the exact 16-file package with verified remote evidence (manifest SHA-256 and commit hash), requires all 6 Draft 2020-12 Schemas and 6 candidate/template instances to be validated, mandates five role envelope checks with ephemeral in-memory fixtures only, and requires all 32 declared negative and mutation cases to produce REJECT. Result persistence is correctly scoped outside the 16-file package. The zero network/credential/model boundary is strictly enforced with explicit counters required to remain at zero. Execution separation is preserved by explicitly distinguishing this offline validation from any CE-G13 execution Decision. All non-authorizations are complete and authority boundaries are preserved through clear disclaimers that this recommendation authorizes no validation, HTTP, credential access, model request, or technical reuse. The recommendation correctly positions itself as advisory pending a separate Human Decision and qualifying Decision review.
